records.title: DFAMS: Dynamic-flow guided Federated Alignment based Multi-prototype Search
records.reason: DFAMS is a dynamic-flow federated alignment/multi-prototype search method evaluated for retrieval/alignment performance. It is not transformer compression, LLM inference, or model serving, and the linked MiniLM distillation item is not methodologically connected.

records.title: GPAS: Accelerating Convergence of LLM Pretraining via Gradient-Preserving Activation Scaling
records.reason: GPAS rescales activations while preserving gradients to accelerate LLM pretraining convergence; evaluations concern training stability/convergence and model quality. No inference latency, memory, throughput or serving optimization is demonstrated. Relatedness to a general transformer-training lineage is plausible, but it is outside the requested inference-efficiency focus.

records.title: KETCHUP: K-Step Return Estimation for Sequential Knowledge Distillation
records.reason: KETCHUP changes sequential knowledge-distillation target estimation using k-step returns and evaluates student task quality/training behavior. It may improve the training process but does not establish smaller deployed model or inference resource savings. Relation to MiniLM distillation is real at the training-method level but weak for inference systems.

records.title: Computation Mechanism Behind LLM Position Generalization
records.reason: The paper analyzes why LLMs generalize to unseen positions and tests mechanistic hypotheses with controlled model/intervention experiments. Its focus is explanatory position generalization, not extending context with reduced KV memory or lowering inference cost; link to InfLLM is conceptual only.

records.title: Elucidating the Preconditioning in Consistency Distillation
records.reason: This work studies preconditioning in consistency distillation for diffusion/generative models and evaluates convergence/sample quality. It is not transformer LLM inference, compression or sparse attention; linked SpargeAttn overlap is not a technical connection.
